kind: retrospective concept/render feedback; user-selected SciTek geometry preserved

concept.verdict: Useful broad arched-wing/central-body/one-engine layout. Added collar routing, small attachments and wingtip endcap details are interpretations; exact outline and markings remain legacy-controlled.

reference.kind: Actual original PS06.VID frames 0/15/30/45 cropped from existing private comparison

feedback: Legacy, concept and GLB preserve one continuous arched transverse wing, a long forward central body, red upper markings and one large bronze aft/underside engine.
The concept follows the broad flowing red legacy marking more closely than the GLB narrow continuous crown stripe. Its small routed lines, endcap and underside attachments remain interpretations.
Current canonical GLB wing has a simpler flatter chord/shoulder outline, central body a more cylindrical cross-section and slender transition than the legacy/concept faceted forebody.
Existing GLB finish is simpler and smoother than the concept. This review does not replace the canonical SciTek source, claim exact fidelity or retrofit additional detail.
